title: Beneath the City of Lights
content:
Shreya smiled as she looked at Yagnesh.

"Hi."

Yagnesh smiled back.

"Hi."

She tilted her head curiously.

"What are you doing here?"

Yagnesh looked toward the glittering Eiffel Tower before replying with a playful smile.

"I came to see the most beautiful view in Paris."

Shreya instinctively looked toward the Eiffel Tower.

"It really is beautiful."

Yagnesh chuckled softly.

"I wasn't talking about the tower."

Shreya blinked in confusion.

"Then... what were you talking about?"

Yagnesh looked into her eyes for a brief moment before smiling.

"I'll tell you someday."

A faint blush spread across Shreya's cheeks.

To hide her embarrassment, she quickly changed the subject.

"Would you like to explore Paris with me tonight?"

For a second...

Yagnesh wondered if he had heard her correctly.

"You mean..."

"Together?"

Shreya nodded with a gentle smile.

"If you don't have any other plans."

A wide smile instantly appeared on Yagnesh's face.

"I'd love to."

The two of them began walking through the beautifully illuminated streets of Paris.

The cool night breeze carried the laughter of tourists, the soft melodies of street musicians, and the fragrance of freshly baked pastries drifting from nearby cafés.

Every corner of the city felt alive.

As they wandered through the streets, Shreya slowly began sharing stories from her childhood, her college days, and the life she had built in France.

For the first time in years...

She spoke without pretending to be someone else.

She laughed freely.

She smiled without forcing it.

And somewhere along the way...

She forgot the burden she had been carrying for so long.

Yagnesh listened quietly.

He never interrupted.

He simply listened.

Whenever she laughed...

He laughed with her.

Whenever she became emotional...

He stayed beside her without saying a word.

His kindness wasn't loud.

It was gentle.

And somehow...

That gentle kindness slowly found its way into Shreya's heart.

Without even realizing it...

She had begun to enjoy his company far more than she had expected.

Hours slipped by unnoticed.

By the time they glanced at the clock...

It was already ten at night.

Shreya smiled.

"I'm hungry."

Yagnesh laughed softly.

"Then let's eat."

The two of them walked into one of Paris's most popular restaurants and ordered their favourite dishes.

While waiting for the food...

A notification suddenly appeared on Yagnesh's phone.

His eyes lit up immediately.

"The new episode is out!"

Shreya's face brightened with excitement.

"Already?"

"I've been waiting all week for this!"

She quickly took out her phone, connected her earbuds, and eagerly opened the episode.

A few moments later...

She noticed Yagnesh sitting unusually quietly.

She removed one earbud.

"What happened?"

Yagnesh forced a smile.

"My phone died."

"I forgot to charge it."

The disappointment in his voice was impossible to hide.

He had been waiting for the episode just as eagerly.

Shreya looked at him for a few seconds.

Then...

Without saying a word...

She stood up.

Walked around the table.

Pulled the chair beside him.

And sat down next to him.

Yagnesh looked at her in confusion.

Shreya held out one of her earbuds.

"Here."

Yagnesh blinked.

"But..."

Shreya smiled warmly.

"Take it."

"Watching anime alone is never as fun."

A smile slowly spread across Yagnesh's face.

He accepted the earbud.

The two of them sat shoulder to shoulder, quietly watching the episode together.

Every exciting scene made them laugh.

Every emotional scene left them speechless.

Without realizing it...

The distance between them quietly disappeared.

By the time dinner was over...

They no longer felt like two people who had recently met.

They felt like two hearts slowly discovering comfort in each other's company.

After leaving the restaurant...

They returned to the place where the evening had begun.

The Eiffel Tower.

Bathed in thousands of golden lights, it stood majestically beneath the clear night sky.

A cool breeze swept gently through the open square.

For a while...

Neither of them spoke.

They simply stood there, admiring the breathtaking view before them.

Yagnesh stole another glance at Shreya.

The golden lights reflected in her eyes, making them sparkle even more beautifully.

For the first time...

He wished the night would never end.

He wanted to tell her everything that was in his heart.

But no matter how hard he tried...

The words refused to come.

Just then...

Shreya slowly turned toward him.

"Yagnesh..."

"I have something important to tell you."

Yagnesh looked at her curiously.

"What is it, Shreya?"

Shreya took a slow, nervous breath.

The smile on her face slowly faded.

She looked directly into his eyes.

Then...

She finally began to speak.
